payload.description: The organization is the unit of enablement. tenant_id remains the identifier; Organization is the product object it names. Adds Organization, Membership, Invitation, and Identity records to the existing table, with a reverse index item so a user can list their organizations without a GSI. Anyone may sign in and create an organization, which lands it pending. Invited members of an enabled organization skip the waitlist. Enabling an organization is the spend decision: it approves one organization computer.
payload.title: Organizations, membership, and the waitlist
